# Hard-coded / non-localized strings (generated by tools/content/*.py)

Scope: `NihongoLife/Assets/NihongoLife/**/*.cs` excluding Editor/Tests. Heuristic scan, 2026-10-28. File paths relative to `Assets/NihongoLife/` unless noted.

## A. User-visible literals assigned/passed to UI sinks without `Loc.*` (130)

Fix: wrap in `Loc.T(vi,en,ja)` (or `Loc.F`) ? the ru table is keyed by the English text, so the `en` argument must be added to `ru_table.json` (run `tools/content/extract_loc.py` + `build_master.py` again, add ru, run `build_ru.py`).

Notes: entries that are only `{interpolation}` + markup are **false positives for translation** but listed because they embed Japanese/Vietnamese fragments (e.g. `??`, `??????`, `?i?m cao nh?t c?a b?n`) that are not localized.
